summary: Pull A day. Breakfast and pre-workout stay quick grab-and-go (protein smoothie, eggs, turkey, bagel) since those haven't needed changes. Lunch brings in Mary's Free-Range Negi Miso Sesame Chicken for variety after the last three days of turkey/chicken-bowl plates, with extra chicken breast, pasta and black beans. Dinner introduces Camarones a la Diabla shrimp as a new protein for variety, backed up with chicken breast, black beans, pasta and avocado to keep it protein-forward.
